children.game_version: A 'Red Light, Green Light' style game where 'Sela' is slow motion, 'Selalarki' is fast running in place, and 'Selabhadoni' is swaying like trees.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the Sela steps as seated toe-taps; for Selalarki, use faster hand-claps; for Selabhadoni, perform the torso swaying while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Use a chair for balance during the footwork phases; reduce the speed of Selalarki to a comfortable brisk walk.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Keep the swaying motion within a narrow range to protect the lower back.

learning_units.description: Sela Footwork: Mastering the slow, steady pulse of the initial phase.
Selalarki Transition: Increasing footwork speed and energy.
Selabhadoni Sway: Ceasing footwork to focus on rhythmic body swaying.

social_formats.description: Inter-village communal gathering where multiple groups converge.

movement_profile.footwork: Starts slow and steady (Sela), becomes fast and energetic (Selalarki), and stops during the final phase (Selabhadoni).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Communal gathering; dancers from different villages converge in a shared space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Swaying motion is the primary focus during the final Selabhadoni phase.

signature_moves.description: Steady and slow footwork performed at the start of the dance.
signature_moves.name: Sela

signature_moves.description: Fast and energetic footwork that forms the second part of the dance.
signature_moves.name: Selalarki

signature_moves.description: The final phase where footwork stops and the body sways.
signature_moves.name: Selabhadoni

movement_profile.tempo_feel: A progressive acceleration followed by a rhythmic settling.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Do not continue footwork during the Selabhadoni phase; the transition to swaying is mandatory.

music_profile.musical_form: Ternary structure based on the phases Sela, Selalarki, and Selabhadoni.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Three-phase progression: slow, then fast, then swaying pulse.
music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape is defined by a clear shift in tempo that mirrors the three phases of the dance. It begins with a slow, deliberate pace during the Sela phase, accelerates into a high-energy rhythmic drive for Selalarki, and settles into a tempo conducive to body swaying for the final Selabhadoni section.

basic_steps: Sela: Perform slow, steady rhythmic steps to establish the beat.
Selalarki: Increase the speed of the footwork, making the steps energetic and rapid.
Selabhadoni: Cease all footwork and transition into a rhythmic swaying of the torso.
teaching.level_notes: The challenge lies in the transition from the high-energy footwork of the second phase to the controlled swaying of the third.
teaching.rhythm: Accelerando structure: starts slow, moves to fast, ends with a swaying pulse.
